info.title: Rescrow HTTP API
info.description: M2 API. Quantities are canonical signed decimal strings; UTC timestamps are epoch milliseconds. Resources are tenant-scoped and reservations are tenant+authorized-namespace scoped. Unknown outcomes may have applied: never replace their reservation identity. Atomic memory and local file adapters only; no regional or enterprise qualification.

Authority-Generation.description: Stable initialized authority identity; changes when authority is replaced.

Location.description: Relative resource/reservation status path; no tenant in path.

Retry-After.description: Integer seconds before retry of identical request.

workloadBearer.description: Pinned RS256, ES256 or EdDSA public keys from configured issuers/audiences. Verified exp, optional nbf, tenant, namespace, credential_id, scopes, resource grants. No token-selected key URL retrieval.

Require-Durability-Profile.name: Require-Durability-Profile
Require-Durability-Profile.description: Minimum profile, verified against actual authority capabilities.

Require-Authority-Generation.name: Require-Authority-Generation
Require-Authority-Generation.description: Expected stable authority identity. Mandatory in clients configured for alternate endpoint fallback.

Idempotency-Key.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency-Key.description: Generate once before the first attempt; preserve the identity and exact intent on every retry. Timestamp: 24-hour replay window, at most 5-minute future skew. Prepared requests remain replayable beyond the window.

id.name: id
id.description: Domain ID; dot-only IDs use ~Lg for . and ~Li4 for .. to avoid URL normalization. All other legal IDs use their literal URL-safe form.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Page length, at most configured page_size (default 100).

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque signed keyset cursor, valid for 15 minutes and bound to authority, tenant, namespace, current policy, endpoint and filters. Lists are not a snapshot across pages.

Decimal.description: Canonical signed i128 decimal string. Range -170141183460469231731687303715884105728 through 170141183460469231731687303715884105727. Reservations cannot be zero or the signed minimum; actuals may be zero. No float conversion.

TimestampMs.description: Milliseconds since Unix epoch, UTC. No second timestamp representation.

Context.description: At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes across keys and values; each value at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Duplicate JSON object keys are rejected recursively.

Prepare.description: UUIDv7 is supplied in Idempotency-Key. Tenant and namespace are selected solely by verified credentials; namespace is an optional equality assertion. Configured participant limit defaults to 64 (supported ceiling 1024). Hold omission/null means no automatic lapse; context omission means empty.

Commit.description: Omitted/null actuals commits the entire reservation. Otherwise every operation appears exactly once, same direction and at most reserved magnitude. A retry must agree with the existing actuals.

Reservation.description: Status is authoritative at observation. Atomic adapters materialize all participants in the same publication; complete is the only current materialization state. 202 requires read-only proof of an exact durable preparation after an in-flight request times out; processing is true. GET/replay normally has processing=false. Never authorizes external work by itself.

Observation.description: Read-only sample, not a reservation or a cross-request snapshot. A later reservation can consume displayed availability. Overdue holds remain visible until a write lapses them.

Links.description: Relative links on the same configured origin; never infer new endpoint hosts from response links.

Problem.description: Typed Application problem. Unknown/deadline outcomes may have been applied; retain the same identity, intent and actuals. Retry-After on retryable problems; WWW-Authenticate on 401. Other-tenant absence returns 404.
